search_space: For X = {0,1} with the discrete topology and V = X x X, the program exhaustively checks all 16 binary relations R on X as the constant positive-index tail in templates V_0 = V and V_n = R for every n > 0.
witness_description: Let X = {0,1} have the discrete topology, let Delta = {(0,0),(1,1)}, and set V = X x X. One sequence has V_0 = V and V_n = Delta for every n > 0; another has V_n = V for every n >= 0.
refutation_explanation: Both sequences consist of neighborhoods of Delta and are symmetric at every positive index. For the first, Delta composed with Delta is Delta, which is contained in V_0 and every later Delta. For the second, V composed with V is V. The sequences disagree at n = 1, so the asserted uniqueness fails.
